# VotingContract ABI

Placeholder ABI for the `VotingContract` smart contract.

**Replace `VotingContract.json` with the real ABI** generated by your Solidity compiler
after deploying the contract. The ABI must include at minimum the following functions:

- `createElection(string name, string description, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime)`
- `getElection(uint256 electionId)`
- `addCandidate(uint256 electionId, string name, string description)`
- `getCandidate(uint256 electionId, uint256 candidateNumber)`
- `getCandidateCount(uint256 electionId)`
- `registerVoterHashes(uint256 electionId, uint256[] hashes)`
- `setMerkleRoot(uint256 electionId, uint256 merkleRoot)`
- `getVoterHashes(uint256 electionId)`
- `openElection(uint256 electionId)`
- `castVote(uint256 electionId, uint256[8] proof, uint256[] publicSignals)`
- `closeElection(uint256 electionId)`
- `getResults(uint256 electionId)`
